rules: No Inter for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond.
Headings must have tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Numbering chapters (01, 02) should be wide spaced (tracking-[0.2em]) and tiny.

surfaces: Thin gold hairline borders for cards and gallery items.
No generic 8px or 16px border radiuses. Use sharp 0px corners or extremely subtle 2px for precision.
Matte finishes. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use 1px inner borders for depth.
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: bg-black/40 for perfect contrast. Do not use opaque backgrounds that kill the image.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow gold marquee strip with text-sm or text-base tracking-widest uppercase.

layouts.spacing: Generous asymmetry. Use p-12 to p-24 minimum. Elements should breathe.
layouts.grid: Bento Grid Protocol Mode A (Asymmetric grids for gallery).
structure: Header: Dark nav bar, glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60. Sticky z-50. Navigation must be visible on desktop.
Hero: Full viewport. High-res bg, kinetic line-by-line masked text reveal. Status badge 'Currently OPEN'.
Services: Dark charcoal (#1A1A1A) panels, thin gold borders. Minimum 4 cards. Use flex/grid layout with ample internal padding (p-8).
Gallery: 4-item grid, asymmetric sizes if possible, thin gold frames. Spotlighted photography.
Reviews: Rating badge first, then cards with reviewer details.
Visit (Booking & Hours): 2-column layout (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2). Map on left, interactive dark mode styling. Hours and booking form right.
Footer: Deep black #0D0D0D, massive py-24 spacing. Center crown/wing icon.

specs.hero_reveal: Staggered line-by-line reveal using overflow-hidden wrapper and y: 100% to 0%. Easing: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] (Custom cubic-bezier), duration: 1.2s.
specs.scroll_reveals: Sections fade up (y: 40, opacity: 0 to 1) with view triggered framer-motion 'whileInView'. Viewport margin: '-100px'.
specs.micro_interactions: Hover states on panels scale up slightly (scale: 1.02) and borders illuminate to solid gold (#D4AF37).

rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Text over images must have text-shadow or gradient scrims.
Visible focus states: ring-1 ring-[#D4AF37] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#0D0D0D].

hero_background.description: A classic barber chair inside a stylish dark salon.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
Do NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
MUST use Shadcn components for interactive logic (Forms, Modals, Inputs) but heavily customize them with pure Tailwind CSS to remove the default Vercel-look.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements include data-testid attributes.
